title: Why Claude can't cite a wrong line

sources.quote: if (end > lineCount) return `lines ${start}-${end} past end of file (${lineCount} lines)`;

sentences.speaker: stewie
sentences.text: So when Claude answers in the chat, does it just make up line numbers?

sentences.speaker: peter
sentences.text: Nope, every source goes through a citation check first.

sentences.speaker: stewie
sentences.text: And if the line does not exist?

sentences.speaker: peter
sentences.text: Then the whole reply is refused, with the reason.

sentences.speaker: stewie
sentences.text: What counts as a bad line, smart guy?

sentences.speaker: peter
sentences.text: A line range that runs past the end of the file.

sentences.speaker: stewie
sentences.text: Huh, so no more invented sources.

sentences.speaker: peter
sentences.text: Exactly, a wrong line never reaches your screen.
